select wms_storage_locations.* ,wms_warehouses.warehouse_name warehouseName,wms_storage_zones.zone_name zoneName from wms_storage_locations left join wms_storage_zones on wms_storage_locations.zone_id = wms_storage_zones.id left join wms_warehouses on wms_storage_zones.warehouse_id = wms_warehouses.id
AND wms_storage_locations.location_code like concat('%',#{locationCode},'%')
AND wms_storage_locations.location_category = #{locationCategory}
AND wms_storage_locations.location_type = #{locationType}
AND wms_storage_locations.status like concat('%',#{status},'%')
AND wms_storage_locations.warehouse_id like concat('%',#{warehouseId},'%')
AND wms_storage_locations.zone_id like concat('%',#{zoneId},'%')
AND wms_storage_locations.location_aisle like concat('%',#{locationAisle},'%')
AND wms_storage_locations.location_line like concat('%',#{locationLine},'%')
AND wms_storage_locations.location_rank like concat('%',#{locationRank},'%')
AND wms_storage_locations.location_layer like concat('%',#{locationLayer},'%')
AND wms_storage_locations.is_sellable = #{isSellable}
AND wms_warehouses.warehouse_name like concat('%',#{warehouseName},'%')
AND wms_storage_zones.zone_name like concat('%',#{zoneName},'%')
